verdict.rationale: Data portability is a fair question for llama.cpp, which ships a built-in web UI and server, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no export of conversations, settings, or other user data into open formats. Mentions of GGUF model names and the open-source, local, dependency-free implementation are adjacent and do not show a documented data-export capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
